notes: The list of five commanders writes לְ on three names and the object marker אֵת on two; the ASV renders every one as a bare apposition, so all five morphemes are unrepresented under rules 16 and 40. The gloss *with* on the two markers is the display aid's error for the homograph H854 and is not read (rules 37, 39).

The single written *the* of *the seventh year* goes to the assimilated article on the preposition as the first article of the phrase (rules 12, 47); the ordinal's agreement article is unrepresented. `בַבְּרִית` → *into covenant* writes no determiner, so that assimilated article is unrepresented too.
